newsitem.title: USA: Paxson says ends pact with Global.
newsitem.headline: Paxson says ends pact with Global.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said Friday it has terminated an agreement signed last month to sell to Global Broadcasting Systems Inc its option on WNGM TV-34, serving the Atlanta market.
Paxson said the agreement was terminated because of an alleged "material breach of contract" by Global involving its failure to make the required $5.0 million escrow deposit.
Paxson currently operates WNGM TV-34 according to a time brokerage agreement with an option to purchase the station from Whitehead Media Inc.
